title: gorgias-developers
snippet:
🤖 1. Join Developer Portal
Sign up for our [Developer Portal](https://partners.gorgias.com/signup) to start our partnership. This step is required only if you plan to build a Public app.

title: Building a high-quality Gorgias app
snippet:
To get full access to all Gorgias API features, be listed on the Gorgias App Store, and qualify for exclusive partner benefits, your app needs to use OAuth2 for authentication.

We expect all partners to wisely choose [which scopes they request](https://developers.gorgias.com/docs/oauth2-scopes). If your app is requesting access to data that isn’t needed for your app use case, we will ask you to update the scopes you are accessing.

title: App partners
snippet:
Our Developer Portal has everything you need to manage and track your app with Gorgias. Create and submit updates to your app, access support and documentation, and get insights into how many people are activating your app from our platform.

title: Gorgias Agency Partner Program
snippet:
The Gorgias partner program was built for anyone whose goal is to help online businesses scale and want to include Gorgias in their offering. We offer one of the most generous partnership programs within the eCommerce ecosystem.

**Gorgias Partner**
A Gorgias partner is someone who wants to be rewarded for referring their clients to sign up with Gorgias.
**Requirements**
- Schedule an onboarding call with a Partner Manager
- Complete the Gorgias Partner Training
**Benefits**
- A 20% rev share for all referrals
- Client incentives
- Listed in our partner directory
- Team training and educational resources
**Gorgias Premier Partner**
A Gorgias premier partner is for someone who not only wants to refer their clients but also add to their service offering, build awareness for their agency, and showcase our partnership together. Unlike most partner programs, becoming a premier partner **DOES NOT** require a strict number of referrals or revenue generated (we only require 1). There are also many more benefits to becoming a premier partner including an even more generous revenue share model.
**Requirements**
- Schedule an onboarding call with a Partner Manager
- Complete the Gorgias Partner Training
- Close **JUST** 1 lead
- Add the Gorgias logo to your website and embed Partner Tracking link
- Include Gorgias in your client proposals
- Schedule a lunch and learn for your team
**Benefits**
- 15% upfront of the ACV + the 20% rev share (for example receive $540 upfront when a referral signs up on our pro plan + $60 monthly)
- Client incentives
- An event and sponsorship budget + priority co-marketing opportunities
- A dedicated Partner Manager
